name: Kogai
notes: Amazing Japanese food selection and cozy ambience.

name: Daaru Next Door
notes:
Affordable drinks, millennial-loved Bollywood songs with enough food options.
Definitely a place to go to get drunk and have a good time!

name: Saraya Cafe & Speciality Coffee
notes: Delicious coffee with their own roastery. They also sell all sorts of coffee equipments like grinder, tamper, mugs, even porta filters.

name: Sharjah Museum of Islamic Civilization
location: Al Mujarrah - Hay Al Sharq - Al Nabba - Sharjah - United Arab Emirates
notes: Insightful museum that tells a lot of things about the history of Islam and its impact in the West Asia and the world. The museum is full of actual demos of earliest water clocks, mathematical instruments, etc. that I particularly loved.

name: Rain Room
location: 26 St - Al Majarra - Sharjah - United Arab Emirates
notes: This is an art installation. Wherever you stand, it doesn't rain and everywhere else it rains. Picturesque and calming.

name: House of Wisdom
location: 8G94+9C8 - Al Juraina 1 - Sharjah - United Arab Emirates
notes: This is the epitome of a public library. It has a huge collection of books, lots of places to sit and discuss (indoors and outdoors). The restaurant/cafe inside is also top notch, though slightly expensive.

name: Madurai Biriyani Restaurant
location: Al Ahmed Building - near Muwailah Park - Muwaileh Commercial - Industrial Area - Sharjah - United Arab Emirates
notes: This place has one of the best "South Indian" biryanis I have ever had. Try their mutton nalli (goat bone marrow) biryani which is even better than I had in Chennai. Service is also top notch. 10/10 recommended.

name: Alserkal Avenue
location: 17th St - Al Qouz Ind.first - Al Quoz - Dubai - United Arab Emirates
notes: This is a great arts district where you can walk around to find some good, artful museums and stores. There are minimalistic pieces and contemporary arabic art — all kinds.

name: Julith Coffee & Roastery
location: 1 ,Kunooz - Warehouse 1 6th St - Al Qouz Ind.first - Al Quoz - Dubai - United Arab Emirates
notes: This is top notch coffee place in Dubai. They roast their own beans and they're really fresh. Also, a good place to buy beans if you would like.

name: Wokyo Noodle Bar - Al Seef
location: Heritage Village - AlHamriya, Souk - P3 - Shop 381 Al Seef St - Dubai - United Arab Emirates
notes: What a delicious ramen place! You can sit cross-legged on a table enjoying authentic ramen in the beautiful Al Seef corniche area. I would recommend walking around the corniche to create appetite and then walking around again after delicious (and heavy) meal.

name: The Miners Coffee Naschmarkt
notes: Nice cafe to sit and work at. Delicious cortado and helpful staff. Will recommend!

name: Café Landtmann
notes: This is a historic cafe and restaurant with delicious baked items and good melange. Would recommend for a place close to the University of Wien.

name: Blue Tokai
notes:
Amazing variety of roasts! They have so many beans available and will grind them per order. Desserts are also good — try their carrot cake.
Blue Tokai (Tokai~Thogai~Peacock) is a chain but this location is awesome.

name: Toki
notes: Great hidden place with awesome coffee and delicious Cortado!

name: Beekend
location: ROF Portico (First Floor-07, ROF Portico, Block C, Sushant Lok Phase I, Sector 43, Gurugram, Haryana 122003)
notes: Cozy Korean cafe with good korean food in aesthetically pleasing setting. Definitely try their Bibimbap.

name: Bawarchi Rolls
notes: The best Chicken roll in the whole world... I've had chicken rolls from hundreds of places, but this is definitely the best one.

name: Malkam Cheruvu
notes: Quiten and clean park with a lake to walk around, may catch a good sunset when not cloudy.

name: Roast 24 Seven
notes: Coffee provided with all popular methods of coffee making, amazing taste.

name: The Coforge Public Library
notes: Well maintained public library with no gadgets, no external books allowed, just sit, read and enjoy silently. No fees required for entering and browsing books, only refundable deposit in case you want to borrow books. Absolutely refreshing as a third place.

name: Broadway The Brewery
notes: Hands down the best brewery of Hyderabad, enjoyed it more for a day time drinking and vibes. You can never go wrong with the food, anything you order will be delicious - highlight-puffpastry base pizza- , needless to say beer is must try.

name: 10 Downing Street
notes: Nice pub with different settings whether you want loud music, quieter seating with a view, rooftop with screening or dance floor room. Experienced staff and food that has never disappointed.

name: Karafa
notes: Both good coffee and good food

name: True Black
notes: Coffee place

name: Yum Yum Tree
notes: Mandi and fried fish

name: Archers Coffee
notes: Rated the top 100 roasters in the world. Amazing collection. Also the only place outside India that has Indian coffee beans. (Chikmanglur beans are speciality coffee's best kept secret.)
